# VQube Technologies

> VQube Technologies [VQT] is a global engineering consultancy and technical workforce provider headquartered in Chennai, India. The company delivers multi-disciplinary engineering design, plant layout, numerical simulation (ANSYS CFD/FEA, CAESAR II piping stress), and specialized engineering manpower deputation for the Cement, Mining & Mineral Processing, Oil & Gas, and Industrial Manufacturing sectors across global value chains.

## Corporate Identity & Authority
- **Legal Entity**: VQube Technologies (VQT)
- **Headquarters**: Chennai Global Headquarters, Tamil Nadu 600015, India
- **Executive Leadership**: Vadivelu Dhamodharan (Head - Engineering & Business Solutions)
- **Primary Website**: https://vqubetechnologies.com/
- **Official Inquiries**: infovqubetechnologies@gmail.com
- **Direct Phone / WhatsApp Advisory**: +91 76048 52835 (https://wa.me/917604852835)
- **Design Standards Compliance**: ASME, ASTM, DIN, ISO, API compliant engineering lifecycle delivery
- **Analytical & CAD Toolchain**: ANSYS Fluent (CFD), ANSYS Mechanical (FEA), CAESAR II, Tekla Structures, AutoCAD Plant 3D, AVEVA E3D, SolidWorks

## Core Engineering Services
- [Cement Industry Engineering Services](https://vqubetechnologies.com/#projects): Feasibility studies, FEED, cement plant layouts, pyroprocessing gas ductwork, cyclone preheater flow modeling, clinker cooler airflow optimization, kiln combustion simulation, and platework fabrication drawings.
- [Mining & Mineral Processing Engineering](https://vqubetechnologies.com/#projects): Mine and process plant layouts, slurry hydraulic flow modeling, crushing and screening airflow simulation, discrete element modeling (DEM) for transfer chutes, wear liner design, and bin/hopper structural verification.
- [Oil & Gas Engineering (Upstream & Downstream)](https://vqubetechnologies.com/#projects): FEED, 3D plant modeling, CAESAR II piping stress analysis, nozzle load verification, thermal expansion support design, refinery equipment modeling, and civil/structural engineering.
- [Engineering Manpower Deputation & Recruitment](https://vqubetechnologies.com/#culture): Deployment of specialized, pre-screened technical manpower across 11 disciplines (Mechanical, Civil/Structural, Process, Piping, Electrical, Instrumentation, Planning, Procurement, QA/QC, HSE, CAD Drafting) for short-term and long-term global project assignments.
- [High-Fidelity Numerical Simulation (FEA & CFD)](https://vqubetechnologies.com/#specialisms): Advanced multi-physics computational fluid dynamics and finite element structural dynamics to diagnose vibration, thermal fatigue, pressure drops, and stress concentrations before field fabrication.
